# Document version fixtures (D02)

These are fixed, reviewed input files, not generated by the current serializer in
the test. Their schemas were checked against the repository revisions below.
Each contains Box 1, Separate Cylinder 2, Sketch 3 on Box 1, Extrusion 4 on Sketch 3,
and NEXT_ID 5. Loading clears history. The test checks parameter values, stable IDs,
migration defaults and canonical version-16 roundtrips on Windows and FreeBSD.

| Version | Introducing revision | Distinguishing content and expected migration |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | afbf889 | Inline rectangle (1,2)–(6,8) becomes element 1, next element 2; no constraints |
| 2 | 1e13708 | Two lines and a circle; absent direction token becomes FREE |
| 3 | 34dbb69 | HORIZONTAL line becomes explicit constraint 1; next constraint 2 |
| 4 | 35332c2 | Explicit HORIZONTAL constraint; extrusion still means all profiles |
| 5 | 6589388 | Explicit extrusion profile list containing ID 1 |
| 6 | c70fb2d | Unary COORDINATE_X on a line start; value 0 |
| 7 | 0fb0d8e | EQUAL between lines 1 and 2 |
| 8 | fabbe8b | SYMMETRIC with axis element 4 in the new third-reference slot |
| 9 | 4a3ee2c | POINT_DISTANCE value 4; absent third reference encoded as 0 START |
| 10 | d18a217 | POINT_DISTANCE_X value 10; axis line 4 construction flag true |
| 11 | 72a16d4 | MIDPOINT point-to-line reference |
| 12 | 53775b8 | DIAMETER of circle 3; value 4 |
| 13 | cc8b013 | HORIZONTAL_POINTS between endpoints of line 1 |
| 14 | 385b846 | FIXED circle with value 20 and auxiliary coordinates [20,2] |
| 15 | 2800519 | ARC 5 with radius 3 and sweep 0–1.5; RADIUS constraint |
| 16 | bd93f13 | ELLIPSE 6 with radii 4/2 and rotation 0; center COORDINATE_X |

Earlier absent construction flags become false; absent third references become
nullopt and absent auxiliary values become an empty vector. Versions 1–4 preserve
empty extrusion profiles as the existing all-profile semantic. These fixtures
validate document parsing, not solver satisfaction or OCCT-generated profile IDs.

The CTest target uses an absolute source fixture directory and reads files in
binary mode. A second pass turns LF into CRLF in memory to check platform-neutral
line handling. Corruption tests mutate these fixed fixtures, including truncation
at every required record boundary; they never mutate the fixture files on disk.
